newsitem.title: CHINA: Macau has lower first half 1997 trade deficit.
newsitem.headline: Macau has lower first half 1997 trade deficit.

text.p: Macau posted a trade deficit of 535 million patacas in the first half of 1997, down 28.3 percent from the same period last year, the Macau Statistics and Census Department said on Tuesday.
Total export value, comprising domestic exports and re-exports, amounted to 7.791 billion patacas, up 13 percent, while total import value reached 8.326 percent, up nine percent.
Textiles and garments, which make up 84.2 percent of total export value, increased 20.7 percent, while non-textile exports fell 15.6 percent.
